notes: Devastation Evoker: manage Essence (max 5), use Empowered spells (Fire Breath, Eternity Surge), align Dragonrage burst window.

Disintegrate.description: Primary filler channel (3s). Generates Essence over duration. Highest priority filler.

Pyre.description: Essence spender (3 Essence). Use in burst window or at 5 Essence to prevent cap.

Living Flame.description: Secondary filler. Deals fire or heals based on target.

Fire Breath.description: Empowered spell (1–4 stages). Higher stage = more damage and DoT duration.

Eternity Surge.description: Empowered spell. Highest priority damage CD. Deals massive Arcane damage.

Dragonrage.description: Primary DPS CD. Empowers all spells to max stage instantly during duration.

Shattering Star.description: Debuffs target, causes next Disintegrate to deal massive bonus damage.

Essence Burst.description: Proc: next Pyre or Disintegrate costs 0 Essence. Up to 2 charges.
Essence Burst.expires_action: Spend on Pyre or Disintegrate immediately

Iridescence.description: After Empowered spell: 20% bonus to next 2 spells of matching school.
